mission.title: The Hunt
mission.description: Oversee the decryption of the captured Zion RSI archive and hunt down the Zionites it exposes.

npc.say: We will be monitoring your progress closely, operative.

...
Hm? No, it is all right. I am prepared for the scan.

So I am close...to the mind of a madman. And yet, I am pleased to know it.
But...how different are the things we have done. Were the reasons similar? I wished to believe...
No. No, it eludes me.
You will give him the data, operative--now.
You should talk to the Agent, operative. You do have a...chain of command.
What's that, operator? What do you mean?

phase.briefing:
Operative, the Cypherite leader, Cryptos, has persuaded the Morpheus simulacrum to attempt to unlock the captured Zion RSI signature database.
You are to oversee this attempt. The simulacrum is ready to proceed.

enter.say:
Word is that Cryptos got the sim to agree by promising to tell him why old Morpheus was so obsessed with finding Neo's remains. Nobody knows what he actually told the sim about it, if anything. I wouldn't put it past Cryptos just to make something up...but whatever he said, it seems to have convinced the sim.
Okay, the sim and our security forces are in there. One of the Agents should have the sealed archive.

objective.text: Get the sealed archive from Agent Long

talk.say: Proceed, operative. The data has not been tampered with.

done.say: Okay, the computer there is set up with the decryption scheme. Put the data in, and Machine sensors will scan the Morpheus sim's neural patterns for the key. Hopefully it'll match, and we'll have the decrypted data.

objective.text: Put the sealed archive into the decryption computer

done.say: They're scanning him... Trying his brainwave pattern against the encryption... Hey! It went through! Zion's RSI signature data is decrypted!

objective.text: Get the decrypted archive from the computer

done.say: Okay, they're giving you an escort for this. Take Valda Zhang and Heather Uris outside with you.

objective.text: Lead Valda Zhang and Heather Uris out of the area

phase.briefing: Bring the decrypted archive to my location, operative. We have promised to allow Cryptos to remove any entries containing the RSI signatures of his operatives.

enter.say:
I didn't think the old RSI signatures would apply for operatives who weren't still jacking in through Zion equipment. I guess Cryptos doesn't want to take chances.
No hostiles in sight so far.

talk.say: Give the archive to Cryptos, {player}. We gave our word in exchange for his assistance, and it will be fulfilled.

done.say: I don't like it either, but orders are orders...

objective.text: Give the decrypted archive to Cryptos

done.say:
Mm... Simple enough...
Yes, I have finished.

The behavior of any logical being is predictable once the parameters are known. The Cypherites pride themselves on unpredictability, but Cryptos knows what our reaction will be if this data is damaged.
Thank you, operative. This data will be uploaded and put to use immediately. Prepare yourself for target interception.

Do not worry; I have only removed the entries I said I would remove. After all, I could hardly wish to inhibit your pursuit of Zion.
I can foresee the ruthless efficiency with which the Zionites on that list will be hunted down. It has been years since so many among the awoken will have faced true death here. The bits of data in that archive will make mortal once again those would-be gods.

phase.briefing:
Operative, our pursuit of the Zionites whose RSI signatures we now possess must be as swift as possible. Once Zion learns that we have obtained the data, they will doubtless begin to evacuate the endangered operatives, and the opportunity to deal a crippling blow to their most senior personnel will be lost.
Two of the signatures found in close proximity provide an efficient target. Their signals have been locked. Terminate their RSIs immediately.

enter.say:
"Signal lock" means they can only jack out safely at a hardline. If their RSI is killed while their signal is locked, their emergency jack-out procedure won't work, and they'll be dead--both there and in the Real.
I've got them on my screen. They're all alone in there.

done.say: Termination of target Zion Selective Phage confirmed.

phase.briefing:
Well done, {player}.
Your next target is jacked in with a crew. His crew-mates are more recently awoken; we do not have their RSI signatures on file, and thus cannot lock their signals as we have the primary target's.

enter.say: The rest of the crew being there could make this tricky. Remember, we're only after one target: Vindemiatrix.

complete.say: Whoa! Their whole crew just went offline.

mission.finish:
Signal traceback to Vindemiatrix's ship was successful, and Sentinels caught the hovercraft off-guard. The vessel, and its entire Zionite crew, has been destroyed.
Your activity today has been most productive, {player}. It is...satisfying to know that we are permanently removing long-standing terrorist operatives. Designation of target signatures for termination will continue.
